verses.1: A Psalm of praise. Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all ye lands.
verses.2: Serve the LORD with gladness: come before his presence with singing.
verses.3: Know ye that the LORD he is God: it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
verses.4: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful to him, and bless his name.
verses.5: For the LORD is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.

metadata.source: Derived from Webster's Bible (1833), revised as a poetic KJV-tradition translation filtered through the theology of abiding in Christ.
